dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell me a joke?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's where you say something that makes people laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was very good... But it wasn't really a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: How was it not a joke? Yesterday, I heard Aino say that to Ineffa, and Ineffa laughed. I saw it happen!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, okay. Do you have any more jokes?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Huh? Why did you not laugh? Yesterday, Aino said this while wiping cream on Ineffa's face, and Ineffa laughed. I saw it happen!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Hey! What's that look on your face? Are you planning to say that this isn't a joke either?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: You don't seem to understand jokes... Leave now! I'm finished telling jokes to you!
